text: established zukomp zuxml (see ~/src/github.com/pedrobtz/zukomp/CLAUDE.md) hold unless design doc says otherwise. Naming layer. R exports get short package-specific prefix (komp_, zux_); C ABI gets zu_-family names; entry points registration get package name (R_init_zuxlsx, zuxlsx_get_api); internal-symbols never installed. Nothing reads another library’s ABI (unz*, mz_zip_*, Expat’s XML_*) may re-exported. src/Makevars portable make , OBJECTS listed explicitly — GNU-make conditionals $(wildcard) (force SystemRequirements: GNU make), -W*/optimisation overrides (CRAN policy). Rf_error() outermost .Call. C layers return status enum; Rf_error() R_CheckUserInterrupt() longjmp past free(). Heap state must survive jump belongs external pointer R_RegisterCFinalizerEx(..., TRUE), R_alloc vmaxget/vmaxset. matters zukomp: XLSX read holds ZIP handle, parser column builders live . Tests assert condition classes, never message text (expect_error(..., class = "zuxlsx_zip_error")); wording covered snapshots. Tests self-sufficient (inputs built inside test_that()), self-contained (withr::local_*()), must pass devtools::test(shuffle = TRUE). Fixtures committed, never generated test time, provenance MANIFEST.tsv tools/ generator supports --check reproducibility. CRAN guarantees Python external tooling.
